description: Publish or republish completed edits to an already-public map when the user requests it. Use the revision returned by the final edit or a fresh retrieval. Applies the same permissions, locks, moderation, and restrictions as browser publishing and generates the public preview. Reuse the same idempotency_key and identical arguments after a dropped response. Returns published revision and sync state; pending review or sync must not be reported as a fully delivered publication. On a revision conflict, retrieve the map and reconsider before retrying. To publish a private map first use set_knowmapped_map_visibility with explicit copyright acknowledgement.
name: publish_knowmapped_map
title: Publish KnowMapped map edits
